verdict.rationale: Mem0's own docs show an official SDK: the quickstart says to install it, shows Python and JavaScript usage, and gives a client.add example. That establishes SDKs for building against the memory layer. The evidence stays at quickstart level, though, so the breadth and depth of SDK coverage is unproven. missing for 10: dedicated SDK reference documentation covering the full API surface (search, update, delete, webhooks, export via SDK), explicit package names, versioning or maintenance evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
